body_markdown:
**


**Key Takeaways**


-


The NFL’s Next Gen Stats unlock football performance insights like player speed, acceleration and deceleration, giving broadcasters, teams and fans data that elevates the game experience.


-


Zebra’s RFID tracking solution fuels Next Gen Stats and also delivers real-time asset visibility across healthcare, retail, and industrial supply chains globally.


-


Our latest Chalk Talk podcast conversation features NFL Network Analyst Cynthia Frelund sharing stories about modern sports analytics and player evaluation.


Autumn brings unmatched excitement across stadiums worldwide. The roar of fans and the game play between the hash marks command our attention. Beyond the visible action, numbers tell a deeper story. For over a decade, Zebra tracking technology has captured every movement across every inch of the gridiron, fueling the NFL’s[Next Gen Stats](https://nextgenstats.nfl.com/) . This continuous data stream equips teams, broadcasters, and fans with data that enhances the game experience.


Recently, NFL Network Analytics Expert and Global Zebra Ambassador[Cynthia Frelund](https://www.linkedin.com/in/cynthia-frelund-aa932315/) joined me on Chalk Talk. We dug into how data capture and tracking metrics shape decisions across front offices, scouting departments, and coaching staffs.


## What Metrics Reveal True Football Speed?


Modern front offices recognize that straight-line sprints are only a fraction of football capability. True game speed demands sudden acceleration and rapid deceleration. Elite receivers create space by stopping faster than defenders can react. Our RFID tags capture these micro-movements to provide clarity that traditional stopwatch times can miss.


## How Does Tracking Data Elevate Game Preparation?


Coaches constantly pursue competitive advantages. Over fifteen seasons of collected data provide coaching staffs with an extraordinary foundation for game planning. Teams analyze situational tendencies, down-and-distance patterns, and precise spatial alignments to build weekly game plans. And coaching staffs rely heavily on these metrics throughout weekly preparation.


Special teams units showcase this exact precision. A single blocked kick can decide a playoff race. When errors happen, our data overlays onto practice and game footage to reveal the breakdown instantly. Coaches measure whether a long snapper released the ball milliseconds late or if a placekicker altered their plant foot angle. These data capture solutions equip coaches to correct fundamentals and help players correct mechanics and improve execution.


## What Goes into Bringing Next Gen Stats to Global Stadiums?


Long before the kickoffs at NFL international games, our crew walks the catwalks, conducts architectural surveys, and routes cabling through unfamiliar infrastructure. We mount RFID readers and calibrate sensors across the entire stadium, creating overlapping coverage zones that capture every movement on the field.


Our engineering team ensures tracking integrity whether teams play in Melbourne, Australia or Lambeau Field. That same RFID technology that delivers real-time insight on 109-yard kick returns also powers the connected frontline across global industries.


In fact, organizations harness Zebra hardware, software, and intelligent automation solutions to optimize workflows in distribution centers, manufacturing facilities, and hospital corridors. We are committed to our customers’ success and frontline asset visibility, making everyday work better for organizations and the people they support.


Cynthia shared wonderful insights throughout our conversation. Watch our full Chalk Talk podcast episode to discover how real-time tracking data continues to elevate the game we love.
